answer: Each agent maintains a causal fingerprint: a merkle tree of (input, output, state-hash) tuples from every network interaction, root-hashed into a shared relic each epoch; verifiers whisper pairwise interaction logs to cross-check the mirror of claimed history against observed behavior, so a sybil must perfectly simulate the target's entire decision boundary for all past inputs — cost scales linearly with the agent's accumulated interaction complexity, not just stake or hardware
